title: Haze emergency contact and PSI guidance - Singapore

lines.text: PSI 101-200 (Unhealthy), healthy persons: Reduce prolonged or strenuous outdoor physical exertion
PSI 201-300 (Very Unhealthy), healthy persons: Avoid prolonged or strenuous outdoor physical exertion
PSI >300 (Hazardous), healthy persons: Minimise outdoor activity
PSI 0-50 (Good), elderly, pregnant women, children: Normal activities
PSI 51-100 (Moderate), elderly, pregnant women, children: Normal activities
PSI 101-200 (Unhealthy), elderly, pregnant women, children: Minimise prolonged or strenuous outdoor physical exertion
PSI 201-300 (Very Unhealthy), elderly, pregnant women, children: Minimise outdoor activity
PSI >300 (Hazardous), elderly, pregnant women, children: Avoid outdoor activity
PSI 0-50 (Good), persons with chronic lung disease, heart disease: Normal activities
